# Plasma Zeroconf : auto-generated by CoPilot 2026-09-20; not yet vetted

Cross-platform discovery and advertisement of Plasma pool servers.

## Service Type

Pool servers are advertised via:

  _pool-server._tcp.local

The service record includes:

* host
* port
* service name
* optional subtype(s)

## Major APIs

### Browser

bool ZeroconfStart();
void ZeroconfStop();

PoolServers ZeroconfServers(const char *type = NULL);

RegisterServerHandler(...);
UnregisterServerHandler(...);

### Advertiser

    name,

void zeroconf_server_shutdown(...);
